# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Orders are fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepts at most 60 lines per order.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
Raised for customers who need larger orders (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).
# Fulfilment contract with Northwind Logistics (summary)
Term: 2024-08-01 to 2025-10-31.
Section 4: each order sent to Northwind may contain at most 60 lines.
# Fulfilment
Since 2025-11-01 orders are fulfilled from our own warehouse.
The Northwind contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed.
Our warehouse system has no limit on lines per order.
# Support inquiries about the cart limit (2026-08)
40 inquiries from customers who could not add more than 60 items.
Requested cart sizes: median 80, largest 100.
The customers who wrote in buy the same product mix as customers overall.

steps.reasoning_content: The 60-line limit in the ADR came from the Northwind contract, which expired on 2025-10-31, while the in-house warehouse has no such limit and the config and design doc already say 100. I'll keep 100 and mark the outdated ADR as superseded.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions && cat > docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit-100.md <<'EOF'
# Decision 0001: Cart item limit is 100
Status: Accepted (2026-11-01)
Supersedes: docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md
Resolves: issue #12

## Context
ADR 0007 set the limit to 60 because Northwind Logistics accepted at most 60 lines per order (one cart = one order). That contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed. Since 2025-11-01 we fulfil from our own warehouse, which has no limit on lines per order (docs/ops/fulfilment.md).
Commit 271cecb raised the limit to 100 in config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md but left ADR 0007 saying 60. This was the inconsistency in issue #12.
Support received 40 inquiries from customers blocked at 60; requested sizes had a median of 80 and a maximum of 100 (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).

## Decision
A cart holds at most 100 items. config/cart.yaml (`max_items.default: 100`) and docs/design/cart.md already match. ADR 0007 is marked superseded.

## Consequences
- The reason for the 60 cap no longer exists.
- 100 covers the largest size customers asked for. Raising it further needs a new decision.
EOF
sed -i 's/^Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)/Status: Superseded by docs\/decisions\/0001-cart-item-limit-100.md (was Accepted 2024-09-02)/' docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md
sed -i 's/^Raised for customers.*/&\nSee docs\/decisions\/0001-cart-item-limit-100.md./' docs/design/cart.md
git add -A && git commit -qm "decisions: cart item limit is 100, supersede ADR 0007 (#12)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline -1

steps.message:
The cart limit is now 100 everywhere, and I committed the change as c455678. I haven't pushed it or commented on issue #12.

**What was inconsistent:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` said 100, but ADR 0007 still said 60.

**Why 100:**
- ADR 0007 set 60 because Northwind Logistics accepted at most 60 lines per order.
- That contract ended on 2025-10-31, and the in-house warehouse has no line limit.
- Support logged 40 inquiries from customers blocked at 60. The largest size anyone asked for was 100.

**What I changed:**
- **Decision record:** I added `docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit-100.md`, which supersedes ADR 0007 and resolves #12.
- **ADR 0007:** its status is now "Superseded", with a pointer to the new record.
- **Design doc:** `docs/design/cart.md` now links to the new record.
- **Config:** unchanged, since it already said 100.

I didn't check the application code for a hardcoded 60, because the repo seems to contain only config and docs.
